tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find DRYL Blazor components (DRYL.Components and DRYL.Components.Agents) by name, title, category or purpose. Use this first when you need a component for a job; then call get_component for its exact API.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: The exact public API of one DRYL component: every parameter with type, default and description, the members of every enum it uses, its public methods and a canonical Razor example. DRYL variants are enums, never strings: write an enum value as qualifiedName.Member (e.g. Variant="DrylButton.ButtonVar

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: The CSS custom properties DRYL styles itself with, grouped (colors, glass, accent, spacing, radius, motion, …), with the dark value and — where light mode differs — the light value. Reference these with var(--name) in your CSS instead of writing literal colors, sizes or durations; DRYL follows the u

tools.name: validate_markup
tools.description: Check a Razor snippet's <Dryl…> tags against DRYL's real API before you finish: unknown components, unknown parameters, and enum parameters given a string or a member that does not exist — each with a suggested fix. Call it on every DRYL markup you write or change. It scans tags; it does not compile
